limitations: Walls without explicit thickness use the diagram footprint; no independent wall-back measurement.
Column chamfers follow glyph proportions because no chamfer sizes are provided.
Unlabeled gaps retain plan geometry and have unverified heights.
SW access alcove scope is inferred from the unlabeled white region; separate floor object.
Main ceiling plane is an optional simplification; lighting, equipment and ceiling lattice are omitted.
Reconstructed PDF-dimensioned layout; not a claim of as-built measured accuracy.
